subject.title: feat(nodes): route alerts to the active computer

question: Should OpenClaw adopt gateway-owned active-computer presence across node APIs, model context, and connection-alert routing?
rationale: The code defects are mechanically repairable, but they do not decide whether all proposed protocol, prompt, API, and delivery-policy surfaces should become permanent core contracts; the linked issue remains marked for maintainer product review.

options.title: Adopt the full contract
options.body: Approve all proposed surfaces, then require both blocking repairs and live multi-Mac proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Keep activity in node APIs and CLI while deferring model prompt projection or gateway-owned alert routing.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and close or hold this PR until a maintainer sponsors a different active-computer design.

recommendation.title: Adopt the full contract
recommendation.body: Approve all proposed surfaces, then require both blocking repairs and live multi-Mac proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Merged history shows the strongest ownership across the affected macOS presence, native node, and computer-use paths.
